column1: # Popular / nickname aliases, merged into catalog.json by app/scripts/build-catalog.mjs.
# The id is the final catalog id as shown in the app (NGC 7331, IC 410, Sh2-155, B 33, Abell 21, HCG 92…).
# Group names go on the member you'd frame (or on every member of a small group, so a search lists them all).
# Search ignores case, spaces and punctuation and matches prefixes, so "deer lick" finds "Deer Lick Group".
# --- dark nebulae / Sharpless / vdB that have no name in OpenNGC ---
